Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and files with the SEC under CIK 0001652044. Its website, abc.xyz, is presented as an investor relations home page, so the material available from the site itself is limited to that investor-facing framing rather than a description of operations or products.

No AI products are tracked for Alphabet, and no MCP servers are listed. No individual lawsuits are recorded either, though the company's legal exposure is counted in California, with 237 matters there.
